# Kaiman

> Kaiman is an AI marketing platform that learns about a business and its brand to help create strategies, campaigns, images, videos, presentations and websites.

Kaiman offers a 14-day free trial with 300 credits. The website is available in Spanish and English.

## Product

- [Español](https://www.kaimanstudio.ai/es/): Información del producto, planes y preguntas frecuentes.
- [English](https://www.kaimanstudio.ai/en/): Product overview, plans and frequently asked questions.
- [Create an account](https://app.kaimanstudio.ai/auth/register): Start a free trial.

## Blog

- [Blog en español](https://www.kaimanstudio.ai/es/blogs): Artículos sobre marketing e inteligencia artificial.
- [English blog](https://www.kaimanstudio.ai/en/blogs): Articles about marketing and artificial intelligence.
- [Sitemap](https://www.kaimanstudio.ai/sitemap.xml): Public pages and published articles.
